about_the_game:
Engage in asynchronous Turn-Based Strategy!

Cultivate and evolve unique mushroom species. Compete for dominance across many worlds,  each with a dynamic ecosystem of wind, events and climate.

Grow as BeanStripe or BubbleFins for a taste of the fungi on display!

DEMO Features:

  • Multiplayer with Steam friends

  • Solo vs. CPU opponents, or mix and match

  • Customizable your mushroom builds

  • Mushroom Avatar customizations

  • 4 procedurally developed diverse maps on multiple worlds

  • High re-playability with map configuration, events and more

  • Changing climate: humidity and wind alter your prospects

*Note, Online Matchmaking (vs. unknown players) NOT available. Custom lobbies only.

Multiplayer and solo modes

Challenge Friends or the CPU; whomever lands Spores nearby, thoughtful turn mechanics will provide surprise and discovery on every turn as you cohabitate the living environment.

Show off your favorite spores with funky cosmetics

Procedurally generated maps for varied gameplay

  • Maps utilize procedural generation to foster innovative puzzle-like challenges, including varied shapes, resources, special tiles, and dynamic events.

  • Develop extensive underground networks or concentrate on efficient mushroom cultivation and abilities!

Build customizations

Trial combinations of advanced Mushrooms, each providing unique benefits when cultivated...some grab additional territory, extend Spore range, or even boost resources opportunity.

Inspired by real-world mycology and ecosystems

Developed by solo indie developer and mycology enthusiast Jake Collinge, the mechanics are inspired by real mushroom ecology:

  • Eat detritus ‘waste’ material

  • Parasitize opponent mushrooms

  • Grow above and below ground

  • Form mutual relationships to earn Nitrogen

  • Seek out humus and other resources

  • React to the environment: wind direction, humidity and soil quality

  • Defend your underground territory

  • Cut off opponent resources

  • …and much more

----- Full Game Feature Inclusions -----

Meta progression and unlocks

  • Each playable Spore has secrets to unlock on your quest to thrive.

  • Spend your match earnings in the skill tree to access new Blooms and playstyles, trait abilities, lab definitions and cosmetics.

Diverse mushroom species with unique abilities

SporeBloom: Mycelium Master will greatly expand on the fungi roster, introducing new families of playable blooms, traits, abilities, maps and cosmetics, flexing the immense variety of techniques real mushrooms use to survive

short_description: A fungi-fueled 'battle of nutrition!' Turn-based strategy inspired by mycelium networks and territory control. Produce fantastical mushrooms and expand to outgrow your rivals. Develop peacefully or parasitize your friends in multiplayer and solo play - may the fittest fungi survive!
